_comment: Tuning lives here, not in the lens. Edit + restart bridge.py (2s) instead of rebuilding and pushing a Lens (minutes).

gripper._pid_note: mode 0 = PD. P=1/D=3 are the factory DG-5F developer-recipe defaults.

control._smoothing_note: EMA on the incoming human angles. Lower = smoother + laggier. 0..1, 1 disables.
control._slew_note: Per-joint slew-rate cap. The main protection against a tracking glitch snapping a finger.
control._watchdog_note: No valid packet for this long -> hold the last commanded pose (freeze, do not go limp or snap home).

_joint_order: 0-3 thumb, 4-7 index, 8-11 middle, 12-15 ring, 16-19 pinky. Within a finger: [abduction, mcp, pip, dip]; thumb is [abduction, opposition, mcp, ip].
_range_provenance: Every 'hard' range below is the observed min/max across the 100 factory poses Tesollo ships in DGManager's DG-5F-R recipe file, so each is known-reachable.
_zero_invariant: Each 'in'/'out' pair places human 0 at robot 0, so a relaxed flat hand commands the all-zeros factory neutral pose. bridge.py verifies this at startup and warns if an edit breaks it. Keep it when retuning: it is what makes 'hand goes flat' a predictable, safe resting state.
_inverting: To flip a joint's direction, swap its two 'out' values (keep 'hard' as lo,hi).
